title: What Trump’s Executive Orders Mean for Texas Home Prices
description:

The Trump administration just dropped its new housing proposal—and whether you love him or hate him, one thing is clear: home prices are out of control and something’s gotta give. But what does this plan actually mean for you, especially here in Texas?

In this video, I break down Trump’s 3-part housing strategy and explain—in plain, simple terms—how it could affect buyers and sellers in places like Killeen, Fort Cavazos, Austin, and beyond. From relaxing building codes to building on federal land, I’ll show you what could change… and what won’t.

📍 If you're a first-time homebuyer, seller, or investor in Texas—watch this before making any moves.

⏱️ CHAPTERS
00:00 – Trump’s housing plan explained
01:30 – How federal housing policies impact local markets
02:30 – Relaxing building codes: Good or bad for Texas?
05:45 – Less regulation = cheaper homes?
08:10 – Why building on federal land won’t help Texas
10:00 – What this all means for Texas buyers
12:20 – What Texas sellers need to prepare for
14:00 – Final thoughts: focus on what you can control
